headline: Frontline Churn Intensifies Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Since the last edition the war‑map has grown hotter. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest theater, its 24‑hour toll now 171,758 Colonial and 189,104 Warden dead with seventeen ownership changes; casualty streams and enlistments are still accelerating. Linn Mercy continues to drive heavy fighting around Rotdust and Lathair, logging seventeen flips, 54,361 Colonial and 68,418 Warden casualties, and a sharp rise in recruitment. Stonecradle’s activity has risen to thirteen flips, Colonial losses at 53,908 and Warden at 67,983, with both casualty rates and sign‑ups climbing. Farranac Coast has erupted with seven flips in the past day, control now split one Warden to nine Colonial bases, and casualties surging to 46,865 Colonial and 57,923 Warden. Fishermans Row records six flips, Fort Ember the busiest post, and casualties climbing to 11,249 Colonial and 13,374 Warden. Stlican Shelf adds five flips, casualties at 55,155 Colonial and 61,209 Warden, while loss rates on the Colonial side cool. Meanwhile Deadlands, Gutter and the northern Warden‑held sectors have gone quiet, showing no ownership changes in the last twelve hours.
